in_marathi.name: Girjesh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Mountains
in_marathi.long_meaning: Girjesh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Girjesh is a name derived from Sanskrit words 'Gir' meaning mountain and 'Ish' meaning lord. This name is revered in Hindu mythology and is often given to boys in honor of Lord Shiva, who is considered the ruler of mountains.
